toegepas.voor: Gebruik dieselfde woorde as jy oor
toegepas.na: Gebruik dieselfde woorde wanneer jy oor
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'dieselfde woorde' the word 'as' reads first as a comparison ('the same words as you'), so 'wanneer' makes the condition clear.
toegepas.fout: 'dieselfde woorde as jy' first reads as a comparison (the same words as you), so the reader stumbles before seeing it is a condition.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wanneer' makes the condition unambiguous and keeps the same instruction, people and order.

toegepas.blok: Geslaan: die ngoma van die VhaVenda
toegepas.voor: en die vel gee die klank
toegepas.na: en die vel maak die klank
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Klank maak' is the natural collocation and the one the rest of the lesson uses; 'klank gee' is wooden.
toegepas.fout: 'die vel gee die klank' is a slightly wooden verb choice in a lesson whose whole question is how the sound is made.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'maak die klank' is the natural collocation, matches the lesson's own 'klank maak' wording and leaves the claim (the skin produces the sound) unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The indefinite article is the natural form here; stressed 'een' suggests a contrast with several pieces that the sentence does not make.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'een musiekstuk' reads naturally and carries the sense of one single piece followed from start to end, so the swap is lateral at best and may lose that sense.

na_skrywer.voor: hoeveel telle in elke maat is
na_skrywer.na: hoeveel telle daar in elke maat is
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: An existential clause needs 'daar' in natural Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.fout: The existential clause 'hoeveel telle in elke maat is' reads stiffly without 'daar'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real style improvement, but it rewords a glossary definition beyond a plain grammar error, so it must go through the writer for every lesson that carries the term.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat jou eie deel aan die klankprent gedoen het
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat jou eie deel tot die klankprent bygedra het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'wat jou deel aan die klankprent gedoen het' is a calque-like, vague construction; 'tot ... bygedra het' is the idiomatic way to ask what a part added.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'wat jou deel aan die klankprent gedoen het' deliberately echoes the earlier heading 'Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen' (the part's function), and 'tot ... bygedra' changes the preposition and verb, shifting it to 'contribution' and breaking the link that 'dieselfde woorde' in the next sentence relies on.
